items.title: Sheds desktop lower-left attribution sandwich clip
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence recorded on the work item
items.notes:
Independent production spot-check @ b20cf0f (https://waypointstudio.org/apps/shed-hunting/map/).

ESCAPE STILL PRESENT — lower-left clip:
On desktop 1440/1728, Leaflet attribution sits in the gap between ESTIMATED OPPORTUNITY (heat legend) and TODAY'S SEARCH, appearing as a thin dark/yellow clipped sliver. Pixel bands on desktop-1440: legend ~y663–734, sandwich strip ~y774–816, plan ~y823–886. Geometry: attr bottom overlaps plan top (plan-attr overlap). Root cause: desktop floating plan card ignores --sheds-sheet-peek while attribution still uses mobile peek margin-bottom.

Other owner escapes in this spot-check: dual location dots GONE (1 user_gps + 1 search_target, stable); oscillating marker GONE (8 samples, zero jitter under mocked geo); wrong location GONE (Pittsburgh mock); upper-left truncation GONE; unexplained FAB stack GONE (labeled Locate/In/Out/Note/Track/Tools). Console clean; network: open-meteo 429 (honest weather unavailable) + favicon 404 — not escape-class.

VERDICT: SHEDS — NOT SUBSCRIBER READY. Repair authorized: raise desktop attribution above legend stack.
